description: Pipeline execution outcomes, success rate, average duration, and recent runs. Postgres datasource queries the pipeline_runs and pipeline_step_runs tables directly.
title: DevOps Toolkit — Pipeline Execution

query.rawSql: SELECT id AS __value, name AS __text FROM pipelines ORDER BY name

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM pipeline_runs WHERE started_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) END AS rate FROM pipeline_runs WHERE started_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(duration_ms), 0) AS ms FROM pipeline_runs WHERE started_at > now() - interval '24 hours' AND status IN ('succeeded','failed')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM pipeline_runs WHERE started_at > now() - interval '24 hours' AND status = 'cancelled'
SELECT date_trunc('hour', started_at) AS t, status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM pipeline_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: p50 / p95 / p99 duration (ms, completed runs)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__time(started_at) AS time, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p50, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p95, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p99 FROM pipeline_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND status IN ('succeeded','failed') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT r.id::text AS run_id, p.name AS pipeline, r.status, r.triggered_by, r.started_at, r.finished_at, r.duration_ms FROM pipeline_runs r JOIN pipelines p ON p.id = r.pipeline_id WHERE ('$pipeline_id' = '$__all' OR r.pipeline_id IN ($pipeline_id)) ORDER BY r.started_at DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT date_trunc('hour', s.started_at) AS t, s.step_name, 100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS fail_pct FROM pipeline_step_runs s WHERE s.started_at > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
